messages:
Alex: Hey team — pushed a follow-up that reworks the backpressure path and addresses the allocator race we discussed. I also renamed the config flag to `enable_continuous_backpressure` (kept an alias for now to avoid breaking anyone). Added a tiny smoke script at `scripts/smoke/backpressure-smoke.sh` and a short note in the README. Would appreciate a quick sanity pass under ~50rps so we can merge before Friday's deploy window. @Jamie @Sofia can you take a look when you have a minute? thanks :raised_hands:

Jamie: On it, checking locally now. splitting the allocator change made it much easier to follow — nice. Running the smoke script, hitting expected retry behavior so far. One small nit: the error message currently says `failed to allocate` — can we make it `allocation failed` to match existing logs? not blocking.

Sofia: I'll run the canary tests later this afternoon. Quick question: the config rename — did you add a backward-compatible alias or is it a breaking change? if it's breaking we should deprecate over a release.

Alex: Good catch — I kept the old name as an alias in the config loader for one release and documented it in the changelog. Pushed a small follow-up commit (hash: 1755556795) that: 1) adds the alias, 2) updates README, 3) tweaks the error string per Jamie. Also added the smoke script exit codes and an example invocation: ``bash scripts/smoke/backpressure-smoke.sh --rps 50 --duration 30s``

Morgan: Canary ops: I can reserve a slot tonight. Queued a canary as id #462. @merge-bot can you confirm reservation and remind us if smoke fails?

merge-bot: Canary reserved — slot 2024-08-23T22:00Z id=462. Reminder: smoke script must exit 0 for automatic pass.

Jamie: Re-ran smoke against the latest commit (1755556795) — green and logs look consistent. LGTM from my side unless Sofia finds anything unexpected. :thumbsup:

Sofia: Reviewed the changelog + alias behavior, looks good. I ran the canary smoke set (small set of queries) — no regressions. +1 for merge, I'll keep an eye on the canary metrics tonight.

Alex: Awesome, thanks everyone. Planning to merge at 21:30 UTC so canary has warmup time. Release note tag: `fix: allocator race; preserve config alias`

Jamie: Thanks — ping if anything else pops up during canary.

Morgan: All set on my end. Tagging the canary run in ops dashboard.

Alex: done and merged at 21:32 UTC (will follow up if rollback needed).
